routes.name: Sweihan Desert Run
routes.summary: 38.5 km point-to-point track recorded near Sweihan, Abu Dhabi on 12 Sep 2026 by Abchir. This is a real GPS trace, not a drawn line — follow it as a guide, not a guarantee, and drive to the conditions on the day.
routes.tyrePressure: Deflate to ~15 psi before entering soft sand
routes.groupSize: 2+ vehicles — never drive the dunes alone
tips: Ratings here are community defaults — check the track against current conditions.
Sand firmness changes with heat and rain; an easy line in winter can be soft in summer.
